description: NaVSiO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmcm space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.68 Å. V is bonded to six O atoms to form VO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent VO₆ octahedra. There are two shorter (1.95 Å) and four longer (2.20 Å) V-O bond lengths. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six equivalent VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-53°. There are two shorter (1.62 Å) and two longer (1.68 Å) Si-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one V, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent V, and one Si atom.
